newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Ericsson no comment on big order rumour.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson no comment on big order rumour.

text.p: Swedish telecoms group LM Ericsson AB had no comment on a rumour it had won a personal communications services order worth up to 10 billion crowns.
At 1440 the share traded at 208.5 crowns, up five, in turnover totalling 377 million crowns.

"We can't comment on the rumour. I can say that no contract has been signed today. We negotiate continuously all over the world and if negotiations were to result in a contract so big that people are talking about it, we would certainly announce it," Ericsson spokeswoman Lil Laras-Lindgren said.
Ericsson radio spokesman Per Bengtsson told Reuters he was unaware of such a rumour.
"I am not aware of any such rumours. We have never had an order of that size," he said.
